verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Hungry, I come to You
For I know You satisfy

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I am empty, but I know
Your love does not run dry

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
So I wait for You
So I wait for You

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
I'm falling on my knees
Offering all of me

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines: Jesus, You're all this heart is living for

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Broken, I run to You
For Your arms are open wide

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
I am weary, but I know
Your touch restores my life
